JiraState.description: The world's Jira spec with every generated id and credential filled in.

SlackSpec.description: Everything in the world's Slack workspace. Omitted ids, credentials and tokens are generated. Without a spec the world gets one user (alice) and #general.

token.description: Pin the user's token, to act as them with any Slack client.

messages.description: Posted in order before any app is installed, so they send no events.

manifest.description: A Slack app manifest (JSON). Its redirect_urls, scopes, event_subscriptions and interactivity apply in this world.

credentials.description: Pin some or all credentials, e.g. to match secrets your app already has. Real Slack generates them; worlds lets you choose.

install.description: Install the app into the world's workspace. true uses defaults.

installer.description: The user who installs the app. Defaults to the first user.

bot_token.description: Pin the bot token, so a recreated world matches tokens your app already stored.

channels.description: Channel names the bot is a member of.

issues.description: Created in order before any app is installed, so they send no webhooks.

JiraSpec.description: Everything in the world's Jira site. Omitted ids and credentials are generated. Without a spec the site has one user (alice) and project WRLD.

hide_email.description: Hide the email from apps, like a profile with email visibility off. GET /user then has no emailAddress.

callback_urls.description: OAuth 2.0 (3LO) callback URLs. redirect_uri must equal one of them; a * in the host matches one label.

scopes.description: Scopes the app may request (offline_access is always allowed). Defaults to read:jira-work write:jira-work read:jira-user manage:jira-webhook.

credentials.description: Pin the client id and secret, e.g. to match ones your app already has.

project.description: A project key. Defaults to the first project.
